summary: Digital Retina is mandatory inside the target FRANK module. FRANK must be multimodal at minimum across language/text and visual perception. H1/H2/H3 and DOOMSDAY cannot PASS without the visual path.
integration_path: visual source -> Digital Retina physical vision pipeline -> provenance-bound Clay VisualPercept -> thalamic/attention gating -> GWT -> memory/self/world/goals/action
semantic_rule: Raw pixels/tensors/embeddings may remain physical numerical representations. Semantic output entering FRANK is Clay-native. Digital Retina is not a second non-Clay semantic exception; Needle remains the sole intentional non-Clay semantic subsystem.

required_actions.frank: Include Digital Retina in frozen FRANK architecture and one-module/binary identity.
required_actions.harness: Execute deterministic visual fixtures and H1/H2/H3 differential traces including stale/replay/shuffle/lesion/rescue controls.
required_actions.gwt: Measure visual candidate gating, workspace selection/broadcast, causal use and re-entry.
required_actions.claycode: Express VisualPercept identity/provenance/uncertainty and visual causal transitions without semantic escape hatches.
required_actions.claygraph: Represent visual evidence provenance and causal-use edges without conflating raw embeddings with semantic truth.
required_actions.unifieddb: Persist/query/replay VisualPercept identity, temporal validity and source provenance.
required_actions.clay: Keep all cross-cognitive visual semantics Clay-native while permitting compiled numerical vision backing.
required_actions.emergenz: Use matched visual lesions and shuffled/stale controls before attributing multimodal coupling effects to emergence.
